items.text:
As of the review, the gender ideology content in the game is minimal and doesn't have any real impact in gameplay, aside from being able to be 'lovers' with every character you encounter once relationships are high enough, due to an incomplete system.

So long as that remains the case, the game is content wise stellar. Currently many systems need to be polished. A number of bugs exist to iron out, and the stability of the game is dependent on how fast your system is. But for the content in the game once you're used to controls, it is awesome, and you'll be wishing it wasn't as buggy so you could enjoy it more. At least that is how it is for me.

It is honestly one of the most uniqe games I think I have in my collection right now.
items.text_zh:
截至这篇评测，游戏中的性别意识形态内容极少，除了因为系统不完整，当关系值足够高时能够与遇到的每个角色成为“恋人”之外，对玩法没有任何实际影响。

只要情况保持如此，游戏在内容方面就是出色的。目前许多系统需要打磨。还有不少漏洞需要修复，而游戏的稳定性取决于你的系统有多快。但一旦你熟悉了操作，游戏的内容就非常棒，你会希望它没那么多漏洞，这样你就能更享受它。至少对我来说是这样。

老实说，我认为它是我目前收藏中最独特的游戏之一。
